findings.evidence: The body only rewrites `SlashInvariantForm.quotientFunc_mk` and applies `SlashAction.slash_eq_zero_iff`; Mathlib's `quotientFunc` itself has this generic signature.
findings.fix: State it for arbitrary `𝒢 ℋ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)`, `F` with `[FunLike F ℍ ℂ] [SlashInvariantFormClass F 𝒢 k]`, and `q : ℋ ⧸ 𝒢.subgroupOf ℋ`.
findings.issue: `quotientFunc_ne_zero` is restricted to `ModularForm (G Γ) k`, although its proof uses only `FunLike`, `SlashInvariantFormClass`, and an arbitrary quotient coset.

findings.evidence: `ModularForm.norm`, `coe_norm`, and `TauCeti.SlashInvariantForm.mdifferentiable_quotientFunc` are all generic in `𝒢` and `ℋ`; the proof uses no property specific to `G Γ` or `𝒮ℒ`.
findings.fix: Prove the theorem first for arbitrary `𝒢, ℋ` under `[𝒢.IsFiniteRelIndex ℋ] [ℋ.HasDetPlusMinusOne]` and the quotient `Fintype`, then derive this level-one specialization only if the roadmap needs it.
findings.issue: `orderOfVanishingAt_norm` is likewise specialized to the level-one inclusion even though the claimed order/product identity is valid for every modular norm.

summary: Both new declarations unnecessarily specialize generic norm/coset facts to subgroups of `SL(2, ℤ)`.
